text:
Maria (AM): @Sam Eng @Liam - SE quick heads-up — our channel partner AcmeX wants a shared sandbox to validate SSO + request routing for a co-sell demo next week. They need: short perf check (p95 <200ms @256 tokens), SSO walkthru, security questionnaire answers, and a ballpark for 50k tokens/day (hosted). Can we scope a lightweight runbook and an entitlement model? :spiral_calendar_pad:
Sam Eng: +1. Do we know which model family they want to test (llama/opt/redwood-2)? Also which region/tenant — EU or US?
Maria (AM): They prefer Redwood-2-small equivalent and want EU hosting. They asked for private VPC peering if possible but are ok w/ hosted if we document egress/residency.
Liam - SE: EU is fine. For p95 target we'll need dedicated instances for consistent latency; for a quick sandbox we can do a small dedicated pool with autoscale disabled. Estimate: 1 x a2-large-ish equivalent should show whether routing+SSO work.
Anya (PS): I can draft a short runbook and an enablement slide deck. We should include a pre-config checklist: 1) site SAML metadata, 2) allowed redirect URIs, 3) test user creds, 4) network egress ranges.
Sam Eng: For the security questionnaire: mark data at rest encrypted, keys via KMS, logs stored for 30d by default. If they need SOC2 evidence we point to the standard pack. If they want on-prem, that'll be a different quote.
Maria (AM): Good. Pricing ask: 50k tokens/day hosted — can you give a rough monthly ballpark? They want to include it in the co-sell proposal tonight.
Liam - SE: Very rough hosted estimate: with batching and KV cache, ~0.9–1.2M tokens/month -> cost depends on model tier. Quick ballpark: $X–$Y / month (I'll convert to a single number after we pick exact model and quantization). For the sandbox we can offer a 2-week trial credit and provide telemetry access.
Sam Eng: For SSO, here's the minimal SAML attributes we need: uid, email, name. Also we'll add an IdP metadata endpoint. Example SP metadata we can give them:
```
<AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"POST\" Location=\"https://redwood.example/saml/acs\"/>
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood.example\"> ...
```
Liam - SE: I'll create the sandbox runbook in GH and include a basic terraform snippet to create the test tenant and routing policy. Draft snippet:
```
resource \"redwood_tenant\" \"acmex_sandbox\" {
  name = \"acmex-sandbox\"
  region = \"eu-west-1\"
  model = \"redwood-2-small\"
  dedicated = true
}
```
deploy-bot: sandbox-acmex-sandbox provisioned in eu-west-1 (id: sandbox-ff12). Logs available at https://internal.deploy/logs/sandbox-ff12 :white_check_mark:
Anya (PS): I'll build the 15-min enablement deck and include a short demo script: 1) SSO login 2) route to dedicated pool 3) show latency graphs 4) show cost dashboard. Can someone add perf traces to the runbook?
Liam - SE: Will add a short perf-run section with a JMeter/locust header and sample command:
```
locust -f perf/locustfile.py --host https://sandbox.acme.redwood
```
Maria (AM): Perfect. Action items: Liam — create GH runbook + cost estimate (by EOD), Anya — deck + enablement script (tomorrow AM), Sam — security questionnaire answers + SOC2 pointer. I'll draft a short SOW and send to AcmeX once we have the numbers. Thanks all :pray:
Sam Eng: noted, will attach the secq draft in the GH runbook.
Liam - SE: Done — created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pulls/312 (runbook + terraform + perf run notes).
Maria (AM): I'll ping AcmeX with the sandbox link and next steps once PR is merged.
